inclusions.text: Pickup from your Sharm El Sheikh hotel
inclusions.source: The tour begins with a pickup from your Sharm El Sheikh hotel between roughly 7 and 8 AM.
An English-speaking guide accompanies you throughout, with a private air-conditioned vehicle for the road sections and a 4x4 jeep transfer for the off-road sections in the desert interior.

inclusions.text: Private air-conditioned vehicle for the road sections
inclusions.source: An English-speaking guide accompanies you throughout, with a private air-conditioned vehicle for the road sections and a 4x4 jeep transfer for the off-road sections in the desert interior.

inclusions.text: 4x4 jeep transfer for the off-road sections
inclusions.source: An English-speaking guide accompanies you throughout, with a private air-conditioned vehicle for the road sections and a 4x4 jeep transfer for the off-road sections in the desert interior.

inclusions.text: Traditional tea session at a Bedouin village
inclusions.source: Arrive at an authentic Bedouin village to relax, interact with locals, and enjoy a traditional tea session.

inclusions.text: Short walk through the canyon section at Wadi Qunai
inclusions.source: A short walk through the canyon section is included; the longer hike option can be added if your group is up for it.
The camel ride that follows is short — roughly thirty minutes — and worth being honest about.

inclusions.text: Snorkeling session at the Blue Hole
inclusions.source: Dive into a snorkeling session at the famous Blue Hole, exploring vibrant underwater landscapes.
Standard snorkel gear is provided; wetsuits available in cooler months if you prefer.

inclusions.text: Lunch at a seafront restaurant in Dahab
inclusions.source: Lunch is at a seafront restaurant of the guide's choice — fresh fish if you want it, or vegetarian and Bedouin options.

inclusions.text: Return to your hotel via air-conditioned transfer
inclusions.source: Return to your hotel in Sharm El Sheikh via a comfortable, air-conditioned transfer.

exclusions.source: A short walk through the canyon section is included; the longer hike option can be added if your group is up for it.
